signal: Repeated KPI dashboard regardless of user task
evidence_required: Observed unused metrics and task path, screenshot region and user goal
task_impact: Extra navigation can hide the primary action
legitimate_use: A monitoring task legitimately needs multiple indicators.

signal: Decorative gradient has no stated brand, hierarchy or semantic role
evidence_required: Capture and design brief showing absence of a role; compare a solid alternative
legitimate_use: A brand-led or data-encoded gradient may be justified.

signal: Every row is boxed without meaningful grouping
evidence_required: Screenshot regions, grouping rationale and scan comparison
legitimate_use: Separate actionable records may benefit from cards.

signal: Primary and secondary information compete or reading order conflicts
evidence_required: Task goal, screenshot and measured type/spacing hierarchy
task_impact: Users may miss the action or essential status
legitimate_use: Dense expert interfaces may intentionally equalize some controls.

signal: One large radius applied to unrelated roles
evidence_required: Computed radii and captures tied to component semantics
legitimate_use: A coherent rounded identity with clear states can work.

signal: Glass applied over variable content without task value
evidence_required: Light/dark/busy background captures and contrast samples
task_impact: Readability and GPU cost can deteriorate
legitimate_use: A restrained navigation layer can justify translucent separation.

signal: Unexplained variations across equivalent text roles
legitimate_use: Editorial contrast across genuinely different roles can be deliberate.

signal: Related distances have no content or token rationale
evidence_required: Bounding boxes, token mapping and responsive captures
task_impact: Grouping and rhythm may become unclear
legitimate_use: Optical alignment sometimes needs explicit exceptions.

signal: Appearance or wording does not reveal action or state
evidence_required: Keyboard interaction, accessible names and task observation
task_impact: Errors increase when action consequences are unclear
legitimate_use: Novel controls can be valid when tested and explained.

signal: Animation lacks feedback, continuity, explanation or orientation
evidence_required: Real recording, reduced-motion behavior and interaction purpose
task_impact: Distraction, discomfort or extra energy use
legitimate_use: A meaningful transition or educational animation may help.

signal: A visual effect obstructs task completion
evidence_required: Measured task errors, keyboard path and rendered obstruction
task_impact: Aesthetic intent cannot excuse blocked function
legitimate_use: Expressive experience surfaces may intentionally prioritize exploration.

signal: Famous application surface copied without domain rationale
evidence_required: Source provenance, compared composition and independent problem constraints
task_impact: Confuses identity and may import wrong interaction assumptions
legitimate_use: Conventional platform patterns are shared usability knowledge.
